import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('view.sqlite')
cur = conn.cursor()

# Sample module deps
print('=== module_depends_on_module sample ===')
for r in cur.execute('SELECT subject_id, object_id FROM module_depends_on_module LIMIT 20'):
    print(r)

# modules that directly depend on package
print('\n=== modules depending on package ===')
for r in cur.execute(\"SELECT subject_id FROM module_depends_on_package WHERE object_id='package:fx03-legacy'\"):
    print(r)

# service modules
print('\n=== service -> module ===')
for r in cur.execute('SELECT subject_id, object_id FROM service_implements_module ORDER BY subject_id'):
    print(r)

# Check if l8 modules depend on l1 modules
print('\n=== deps from l8 modules ===')
for r in cur.execute(\"\"\"
SELECT m.subject_id, m.object_id 
FROM module_depends_on_module m
JOIN service_implements_module s ON s.object_id = m.subject_id
ORDER BY s.subject_id
LIMIT 30
\"\"\"):
    print(r)
"
